name: Remember (add memory)
description: Append an item to the user's memory list — a short fact to always remember about the user. The item is added to the end and gets the next number. Stored durably in the user's workspace.

text.description: The thing to remember (one short line).

path.description: Workspace path of the memory list (default 'w/memory').

remembered.description: True if the item was added.

n.description: The number of the added item.
